description: This Java source file defines the YarnShuffleService class, an external shuffle service used by Spark on YARN. It manages shuffle data, handles authentication, recovery, and metrics, and interacts with Hadoop and Spark components.

classes.name: YarnShuffleService
classes.description: A class implementing an external shuffle service for Spark on YARN, managing shuffle data, security, recovery, and metrics.

classes.name: YarnShuffleService.AppId
classes.description: A simple class representing an application ID used for shuffle data management.

methods.name: YarnShuffleService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the shuffle service, setting the service name.

methods.name: isAuthenticationEnabled
methods.description: Checks if shuffle data authentication is enabled based on secretManager.

methods.description: Initializes the shuffle service with configuration, sets up server, metrics, and recovery.

methods.name: setShuffleMergeManager
methods.description: Sets a custom shuffle merge manager for testing.

methods.description: Loads application secrets from the database for authentication.

methods.description: Parses a database key to extract application ID.

methods.description: Encodes an application ID into a database key.

methods.name: initializeApplication
methods.description: Handles initialization of a new application, including secrets and recovery.

methods.name: stopApplication
methods.description: Handles cleanup when an application terminates.

methods.name: serviceStop
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops the shuffle service.

methods.description: Sets the recovery path for the service.
